title: Eglin Daily Signal Brief — 2026-07-27 (Monday; Digital Omnibus is law, MCP T-1, 15th null)
summary: Monday brief carries three elevated signals plus the coordination-integrity appendix committed Wednesday and rescheduled Friday to land here. Friday's single-search-index-title signal from gamingtechlaw.com was the correct leading edge; five independent legal-press primary sources over the weekend (NicFab, banking.vision, EU Law Live, Modulos, lawandtechnology.eu) converge on the same publication + EIF + deadline-shift set. Compass EU paragraph swap (across /trust, /compare, EU-facing marketing) and Vector customer-conversation talking-point swap (Cordova + Halcyon EU-nexus tables — the 2 August cliff Stratum tracked with them for eight weeks becomes a sixteen-month planning-horizon expansion) both activate THIS SESSION with pre-drafted swap language. Kernel eval-set v1.3 should add a transparent-marking probe against the 2 December 2026 three-month-compressed deadline. Signal 03 (L4 held) — fifteenth revised-ETA null on the standing Tier 4 coordination-integrity vehicle in twenty-one business days; L4 held without inflation and without silent downgrade; two coordination clocks (standing Tier 4 at 15 nulls, Forge R1 verdict at 4 calendar days elapsed) named cleanly at their current state without folding.
